About Us

Beauty Is Our Passion

Self care is a form of self love

At Hair Spa by Fairies, we believe beauty is more than just a look — it is a feeling. Founded and run by Ishrat Arooj, our salon on Joiya Road in Burewala is a calm, blush-pink, female-only escape where skilled hands, quality products and unhurried care bring out your natural glow. Ishrat personally looks after every guest — from your first consultation to the final finish.

From a quiet hour in the hair spa chair to the full sparkle of your barat day, every visit is personalised — we listen first, then create a look that is entirely yours. We are open 11am to 7pm, by appointment only, for ladies only — no kids, please, so your pamper time stays peaceful.

  • Professional, caring beauty experts
  • Personalised beauty consultations
  • High-quality, safe products
  • Clean, relaxing, stylish salon space
Explore Services

The Experience

The Hair Spa Ritual, Step by Step

Four gentle stages — this is how a Fairy hair spa appointment unfolds.

One

Consult & Unwind

We start with a chat about your hair, your scalp and your day — then you settle in with a warm welcome and let the noise of the city fade.

Two

Cleanse & Massage

A deep, detoxifying cleanse followed by our slow signature head massage — slow, rhythmic strokes designed to melt the whole week's stress away.

Three

Treat & Nourish

Steam opens the hair to a rich treatment mask chosen for your hair type, restoring softness, strength and shine from root to tip.

Four

Style & Shine

A silky blow finish and a final polish of shine — you leave with hair that moves, gleams, and turns heads on Joiya Road.
